title: Walk-Forward Backtest Metrics on XAUUSD (15m) Using Multi-Layer Filtering (Macro, Momentum & News)
author: ScarcityOther6822
selftext:
Hi everyone,I wanted to share some backtest results from a walk-forward simulation on XAUUSD using a 15-minute timeframe.The system implements a combination of Channel Theory and multi-layer structural filtering. 

To address volatility and false breakouts, the logic triggers trades only when specific filters align simultaneously:2-Level Macro ConfirmationMomentum triggersNews Blackout window (restricting trades around high-impact events)

Strict Spread GuardThe current run shows a high profit factor and win rate over 18 trades in this specific sample window, primarily due to the heavy filtering restricting low-probability setups.I am looking to discuss structural filtering techniques. For
